text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"---"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N2","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT :- 1) TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 24-32 HRC. 2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The title block heat_treatment field is '---', which conflicts with note N2 specifying toughening to 24-32 HRC, and neither states when the treatment applies relative to machining. This ambiguity can cause the supplier to skip or mis-sequence hardening, resulting in a shaft that fails in service. Update the title block heat_treatment field to match N2 and specify the stage (e.g., after rough machining, before finish grinding).","recommended_correction":"Change the title block heat_treatment from '---' to 'TOUGHENED 24-32 HRC' and add the processing stage in note N2."}]}
